packages.name: @agent-os/runtime
packages.role: seven backend-neutral runtime Service Tags at the root plus explicit lifecycle, projection, diagnostic, settlement, workspace, wire, host, provider, and testing owner subpaths
packages.boundary: runtime root exports only Admission, BoundaryEvents, Dispatch, Ledger, LedgerArchive, Quota, and Resources. Lifecycle, projection, diagnostic, settlement, workspace, wire, platform/provider, and testing APIs live behind explicit owner subpaths; root JS and declarations must not aggregate them or leak subpath-only peers. The ./ag-ui subpath is a browser-safe projection over runtime-protocol Recorded vocabulary, not the client state model. The ./channel subpath is a pure authored ingress contract for generated targets: define routes, verify provider requests into principals, and receive a restricted submit/dispatch context; channel dedupe, retry, receipt, and replay identity remain app/provider-owned until channel declarations expose a positive delivery-key contract. The ./external-effect subpath is a vocabulary-neutral orchestration join and neutral attempt projection for idempotent external-effect attempts over caller-owned event, request, projection, evidence-ref, and attempt-key types; it must not own claim, ledger event, receipt, witness, store, idempotency derivation, provider material, or product control-plane vocabulary. The ./schedule subpath is a pure authored time-ingress contract for generated targets: define UTC cron declarations, receive a restricted schedule context over product sessions/workflows, dispatch one product handoff, project schedule fire history from schedule fire events plus linked session/workflow/run projections, and use runtime-owned provider-neutral delivery facts for generated schedule ingress: verified delivery key, attempt, receipt, retry status, and replay projection. These authored ingress subpaths are distinct from attached-stream outbound frame channels and must not own provider SDK lifecycle, webhook helpers, provider-normalized events, AgentManifest facts, runtime Scheduler substrate facts, provider callback parsing, raw provider payload storage, or external side-effect lifecycle.

packages.apiStatus: {releaseLine} active development. Public exports are listed for accidental export control; subpath integrations are not independent package boundaries.

packages.boundary: framework-neutral root client state machine surface plus React/Svelte and product-shell subpath adapters; root consumes runtime-protocol Recorded projections through positive ledger-event decoding and injected transports with no React, Svelte, AG-UI, or product UI dependency
packages.need: Agent client core and framework bridges

packages.apiStatus: {releaseLine} active development for the canonical agent client package. Root exports cover framework-neutral stores, transport injection contracts, positive runtime ledger-event decoding, Recorded runtime-event snapshots, symbolic ref lifecycle, and generic command invocation; `./product-shell-client` names the product command plus runtime ledger composition pattern; `./react` and `./svelte` are optional-peer subpath adapters.

packages.name: @agent-os/evals
packages.role: eval authoring DSL, symbolic eval configuration, deterministic assertion declarations, and runner-facing case/context types for generated app behavior checks
packages.boundary: DSL-only public authoring surface. It declares evals, datasets, symbolic provider needs, public-client context facades, and assertion intent; it must not assemble runtime graphs, construct model providers, serve generated apps, import runtime internals, or treat eval result artifacts as source facts.
packages.readmeStatus: {releaseLine} active development. The package is an authoring surface for eval definitions; execution, app serving, provider resolution, and artifact persistence remain owned by the CLI/runtime/client seams.
packages.apiStatus: {releaseLine} active development. Public exports are limited to eval authoring DSL, symbolic config, case/context types, and deterministic assertion declarations.

packages.name: @agent-os/cli

packages.boundary: ProductIntent compiles once into backend-neutral ProductPlan; LocalHost or DeploymentIntent alone owns target, provider, workspace-host, transport, and release facts; renderers consume a closed StaticTargetPlan and do not reinterpret product semantics
packages.readmeStatus: {releaseLine} active development. CLI commands are the supported developer surface; generated projections remain owned by their source facts.
packages.apiStatus: {releaseLine} active development. CLI root exports are the supported developer API; command internals remain implementation details.
